## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL with broad participation. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND confirm upside, while mixed ratio signals and VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND show fear easing but overall flat risk/rates readings keep the call neutral.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit/supportive: HYG (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.64%) ABOVE TREND → flat-to-positive. Equity leadership concentrated: SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +10.95%) ABOVE TREND driving internals.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive. TLT (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND → flat while HYG/LQD ABOVE TREND (see above) indicate credit conditions steady; Dollar and yield-curve metrics remain neutral per the barometer.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech-led momentum: XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Style: Growth/momentum showing strength given XLK + sector breadth confirmation.

5. US vs Global?
US participation strong: SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND. Emerging markets also robust: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +10.56%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +3.87%) ABOVE TREND — global beta generally positive.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Elevated. ARKK (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +10.95%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +9.14%) ABOVE TREND indicate strong risk-on/speculative flows; IWM (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND reflects small-cap participation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/metal strength: CPER (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND. Gold steady: GLD (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, suggesting some hedge demand alongside risk appetite.

8. Energy Trend?
Weak. XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, while UNG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%) RECOVERY — energy remains a source of weakness and dispersion.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCE: XLB (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +7.49%) CORRECTION and several commodity mismatches (WEAT/CORN/UNG) are flagged as MINOR divergences versus broad equity strength.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum exposure via XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND and watch commodities dispersion; bonds neutral-to-monitor via TLT (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for continuation of momentum; SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND showing cyclical tech strength. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND — watch further weakness and headline risk.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND if industrial demand holds. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) BELOW TREND and broad oil complex weakness; monitor UNG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%) RECOVERY for volatility.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health) — HYG (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND, LQD (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.64%) ABOVE TREND. XLK/XLF spread 2.0 (growth vs value pivot) — XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +3.35% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with broad participation: Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and major indices SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND. Technology and momentum areas showing strength — XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +10.95%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is sector/commodity dispersion — energy XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND and several commodity divergences to monitor.
